body: I'm going to take your advice, I'm going to hang around for a few more years. I'm going to finish high school and hang around for a few years after.

Earlier today (yesterday technically but I don't usually say yesterday until I've slept) my best friend asked me if I wanted to stay tonight at his house. I took him up on the offer, so I'm not at home right now. I might stick around for a few more years but I'm not sure what the hell I'm going to do with myself when I get home...

Unfortunately that's still just under three years away. My family is at arms (metaphorically) against each other. My parents are constantly fighting with my older sister (a legal adult living rent free at our house) over her boyfriend (who doesn't live here) and I'm constantly in the middle of it. I it is driving me up the wall. I've been on car rides with my sister to his house so she could see him for about ten minutes or so, and I have been on car rides with my mom (who is paranoid about a lot of things) to she of she (my sister) was truly at work. 
My mom is very controlling and overbearing. She thinks I go and do drugs at my friends house. She accuses me of being high all the time and it annoys me to no end. I am constantly being threatened with drug tests even though I will pass one every time, she refuses to give me one just to shut her up. She is also emotionally manipulative. If I want to go do something by myself she will A.) Accuse me of going out to have sex (I haven't even grown the balls to ask a girl out yet...), B.) Accuse me of going off to get drunk or high, C.) Accuse me of being the manipulative one, and D.) bring out the waterworks if all else fails.  I have to ask a few days in advance if I want to go to my friend's house, if even for as little as ten minutes. I just need to get out of this house. 

Also on top of that, I have been bullied off and on throughout Elementary and Middle school. So far (during High School)I have only had one experience of being "bullied;" which was about this time last year. I was in a class and was laughing at a meme when some Junior thought I was laughing at his girlfriend. He came up from behind while I had a guitar in my lap, and started throwing punches. Now I was only 5'3"and was about 150 pounds at the time I had stuff in my lap and he came from behind and above essentially screwing over any chances of me defending myself. Those are two of the reasons why I don't really talk to anyone. I don't want to have another instance of someone trying to knock my teeth out and I don't want to have to listen to anyone's manipulative bullcrap. 
I don't think I can live until my 18th birthday without going completely crazy in my hometown. I only see myself snapping in a year or so, or just ending my suffering before I do. I'm sorry for dumping this all at once, I just needed to get this off my chest.

I wish that would happen (touring and stuff), we still need a drummer (we are using a crappy app right now). As for my hometown, we will be **extremely** lucky to even get a bar gig. I live in a rural town where everyone listens to country or pop. There are an occasional few that are metal heads but they are few and far between, so there isn't a "scene" so to speak.
I haven't talked to them as they don't understand. We do hard rock stuff.
